_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. delphi.co declares its design-token layer in its stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* and every theme-switching name — Radix-style palette steps, shadcn semantics and Delphi's --fg-*/--surface-*/--mind-* roles — emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each theme resolves its own value. The dark theme is declared, never painted while signed out. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.
